channel.title: Pier & Point · Sophie Maxwell Building
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Sophie Maxwell Building (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Sophie Maxwell Building: The Sophie Maxwell Building's 2026 AIA California design award was shown as a status change. The building was already complete (August 2025); the award is now listed as a milestone.
item.description: The Sophie Maxwell Building's 2026 AIA California design award was shown as a status change. The building was already complete (August 2025); the award is now listed as a milestone. Source: Pier & Point editorial review.
item.source: Pier & Point editorial review

item.title: Correction · Sophie Maxwell Building: The record now says October 2025 was the grand opening and ribbon-cutting and that first residents moved in during November 2025 (Hoodline, citing the SF Chronicle; ABC7 gave Nov 1 only as the planned date); it previously showed October 2025 move-in and Nov 1, 2025 as a settled day. The Essential Housing Fund contribution is now shown as reported on Aug 3, 2026 as expected, with no later confirmation found. Also corrected: the Block 7B contracts figure is described as contracts and change orders (the report does not call them design contracts), 'Enhanced Infrastructure Financing District No. 1' is now just the EIFD the sources name, the Fifth Space rename no longer carries a year, two sources' headline and date were corrected, and a milestone now cites the 2023 annual report for the Oct 2023 site permit.
item.description: The record now says October 2025 was the grand opening and ribbon-cutting and that first residents moved in during November 2025 (Hoodline, citing the SF Chronicle; ABC7 gave Nov 1 only as the planned date); it previously showed October 2025 move-in and Nov 1, 2025 as a settled day. The Essential Housing Fund contribution is now shown as reported on Aug 3, 2026 as expected, with no later confirmation found. Also corrected: the Block 7B contracts figure is described as contracts and change orders (the report does not call them design contracts), 'Enhanced Infrastructure Financing District No. 1' is now just the EIFD the sources name, the Fifth Space rename no longer carries a year, two sources' headline and date were corrected, and a milestone now cites the 2023 annual report for the Oct 2023 site permit. Source: Hoodline, 2025-12-06 (https://hoodline.com/2025/12/s-f-s-new-sophie-maxwell-pads-throw-lifeline-to-city-s-squeezed-middle/); ABC7 San Francisco, 2025-10-20 (https://abc7news.com/post/new-sophie-maxwell-building-open-offering-affordable-essential-housing-middle-class-san-franciscans/18015271/); SF YIMBY, 2025-10-24 (https://sfyimby.com/2025/10/sophie-maxwell-affordable-housing-opens-in-potrero-power-station-san-francisco.html); San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-08-03 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/jpmorgan-housing-san-francisco-22367970.php); California Barrel Company and Found Middle L.P., 2023 Annual Report, 2024-11-22 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station).
